GOOD QUESTIONS

Before you sell.

Do you buy damaged devices?

You can submit details of a damaged or faulty device for assessment. Acceptance depends on the type of damage, repairability, and market value. A purchase is not guaranteed.

Can I sell my Android phone?

Selected Android phones may be eligible. Include the exact model, specifications, condition, and any repair history so G2Cashify can assess quality and current resale value.

How is my offer determined?

Offers consider the model, specifications, working condition, wear, repair history, and current market value. An initial estimate is subject to physical inspection and may change.

What happens during inspection?

The device’s identity, specifications, functionality, and condition are checked against your description. Inspection arrangements and payment details must be confirmed directly with G2Cashify.

How should I prepare my device?

Back up files you want to keep. Before handing over a device, remove your accounts and personal data, and reset or securely erase it using the manufacturer’s guidance. Bring any included accessories and disclose known faults.
